title.zh: 规定建设与安装以美国政府援助购置的灌溉水泵的国家政策，授权灌溉服务处仅向受益农民收取水泵、发动机、配件成本与抵消税，并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Prescribing the National Policy on the Construction and Installation of Irrigation Pumps Acquired with the Assistance of the Government of the United States of America, Authorizing the Irrigation Service Unit to Charge Farmer-Beneficiaries Only the Cost of Pumps, Engines, Accessories and Compensating Tax, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Prescribing the National Policy on the Construction and Installation of Irrigation Pumps Acquired with the Assistance of the Government of the United States of America, Authorizing the Irrigation Service Unit to Charge Farmer-Beneficiaries Only the Cost of Pumps, Engines, Accessories and Compensating Tax, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1962/ra_3471_1962.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: It is hereby declared to be the policy of the Philippine Government to encourage the installation and proper utilization of more pump irrigation systems in order to bring about the social and economic well-being of the people in the rural areas by making available to them irrigation systems to increase production and elevate their standard of living.

To implement the policy declared in Section one hereof, the Department of Public Works and Communications is hereby authorized to charge the farmers-beneficiaries of irrigation systems only the landed cost of the pump, engines and accessories and the compensating tax due thereon.

All amounts paid by the farmers to the National Government on account of irrigation systems already installed at the time of the approval of this Act shall be applied to the payment of pumps, engines, accessories and compensating tax due thereon: Provided, However, That any amount paid in excess of the reassigned cost as a result of the implementation of this Act shall be refunded.

This Act shall apply only to irrigation systems constructed and installed by the Philippine Government with the assistance of the Government of the United States of America. New contracts of purchase of existing irrigation pump systems based on the reassigned cost pursuant to this Act shall be executed between the Government and the farmer-beneficiaries with sufficient collaterals, in lieu of the contracts of purchase now existing between them.
The Department of Public Works and Communications, through the Irrigation Service Unit, shall implement the provisions of this Act.
All laws, executive orders, rules and regulations or portions thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1962.
